title: Link shortener
goal: Build a link shortener web app. The page has a text input with the placeholder "Long URL", a text input with the placeholder "Short code", a button labelled "Shorten", and the list of stored links. Links are stored on the server, each with its long URL, its short code and a click count that starts at 0. Each link is shown as "CODE -> URL", followed by its click count as "CODE: N clicks" and a button labelled "Visit CODE". Clicking Shorten stores the link and shows it. Clicking Visit adds one click to that link on the server and its row shows the new count; the page does not navigate away. Stored links and their counts are shown when the page loads. Links and counts are kept when the server restarts.
